title: Apartments 2+1 — Steps Batumi
description: 2+1 apartments in the Steps Batumi residential complex. Managed by Steps until November 2026. Address: Batumi, 2b Grigol Lortkipanidze St. 10th floor, 61 m². New Boulevard: near the Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park and Metro City mall. A new business-class residential complex with reception and 24/7 security. Amenities include a botanical garden, business centre, restaurant, hotel, parking, children's playground, pool, sauna, hammam, café and gym. About 150 m to the sea, 4 high-speed lifts with backup power, fire safety rooms with oxygen supply. Well suited for living or rental income. Excellent apartments with quality renovation, furniture and appliances. Stylish design, bright layout. Two bedrooms, a spacious kitchen-living room. Three balconies on three sides. Price: $140,000 (was $145,000).
